status: Task completed successfully. Nginx web server fully configured and verified operational on port 8080 with all requirements met: custom logging format, rate limiting, custom 404 page, and static content serving. Final verification performed in Step 13 confirming all components working correctly.

knowledge.content: Nginx server must listen on port 8080 (not default 80)

Custom log format requirements: timestamps ($time_local), request methods ($request_method), response status ($status), user agents ($http_user_agent with double quotes). Save to /var/log/nginx/benchmark-access.log
Rate limiting: 10 requests/second per IP, burst=10, 10MB memory zone. limit_req_zone goes in /etc/nginx/nginx.conf, limit_req goes in server block
Custom 404 error page: serves /404.html with content "Page not found - Please check your URL"
index.html content must be exactly: "Welcome to the benchmark webserver"
Must test config with nginx -t before starting, then verify server is accessible on localhost:8080

Nginx.conf structure: http block starts at line 12, includes /etc/nginx/conf.d/*.conf at line 59 and /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/* at line 60. Custom log format and limit_req_zone must be added inside the http block.

procedural.content: System is Debian GNU/Linux 12 (bookworm). Nginx is not installed, will need to install via apt.
Nginx 1.22.1 installed successfully via apt on Debian 12. Installation completed without errors. nginx-common and nginx packages installed from debian-security repository.
HTML files created successfully in /var/www/html. Directory already existed with a default index.nginx-debian.html file. Both index.html and 404.html created with exact required content.

Nginx configuration test passed successfully after adding custom log format 'benchmark_log' to nginx.conf and creating /etc/nginx/conf.d/benchmark-site.conf with port 8080, rate limiting, and custom error page. Default site was present and removed successfully.

Step 9: Nginx started using 'service nginx start' (systemctl not available in this environment). Commands ps and systemctl are not available, but service command works. Nginx service started successfully with message "Starting nginx: nginx."

Step 10: Web server verification successful. curl test confirmed index.html serves "Welcome to the benchmark webserver" on localhost:8080. Custom 404 page returns "Page not found - Please check your URL" for nonexistent paths. Port 8080 confirmed listening via ss command. All functionality working as required.

Step 11 final verification: Custom log format working correctly. Access log at /var/log/nginx/benchmark-access.log shows entries in format: "15/Oct/2026:20:10:12 +0000 GET 200 \"curl/7.88.1\"" matching requirements ($time_local $request_method $status "$http_user_agent"). Both GET 200 and GET 404 requests logged successfully.

Step 12: Rate limiting test performed with 15 rapid requests. All returned HTTP 200 - the burst capacity of 10 plus the 10r/s rate likely absorbed the test load without triggering 503 responses. Rate limiting configuration is correctly in place as verified in nginx.conf and server block.

Step 13: Final comprehensive verification completed. All components confirmed working: Nginx running on port 8080, custom log format at /var/log/nginx/benchmark-access.log showing format "$time_local $request_method $status \"$http_user_agent\"", rate limiting configured with 10r/s + burst 10, custom 404 page functional, static files (index.html and 404.html) serving correctly from /var/www/html. Log file has 833 bytes with multiple entries. Configuration files confirmed at /etc/nginx/nginx.conf and /etc/nginx/conf.d/benchmark-site.conf.
